basePrompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: ONE production-ready square character portrait for an AI debate sports collectible card, exactly 1024x1024, full-bleed illustration only.
Input image is a visual identity reference. Redesign its yellow robot into a fresh character in the same family, preserving the large glossy sunflower-yellow circular robot face, simple black expressive eyes and mouth, pink cheek marks, visible over-ear headphones, little antenna, small friendly articulated robot hands, thick clean dark forest-green ink contours, warm playful 2D comic cel shading. Simplify the existing detailed illustration into polished designer mascot art, not 3D, not photorealism.
Composition: one character only, centered waist-up bust, head taking about 45% of image width, face center near x=50%,y=37%; antenna fully visible with comfortable top margin, both hands visible inside frame. Overall figure fills 80% height. Same face-to-body proportions and framing throughout this card collection. Plain casual unbranded leisurewear only. Background a single pale flat color and exactly one or at most two large simple flat geometric shapes. Flat soft grounding shadow only; no realistic environment. Character personality through distinct facial expression, pose, headset silhouette and color.
No profession or job cues, no suits, ties, lab coats, uniforms, work tools, tablets, computers, documents, office/court/classroom/scenery, microphones, weapons. No text, letters, names, logos, badges, numbers, speech bubbles, watermarks, card border, extra panels or multiple characters. No elaborate texture, tiny mechanical greebles or busy patterns.
Specific character design:

characters.name: 루미
characters.direction: Upbeat confident welcoming personality. Coral red headphones with round earcups and coral oversized crewneck sweatshirt with ivory ribbed cuffs. A single short antenna with a round red tip. Friendly wide U-shaped smile, dark round eyes, small rosy cheeks. One hand casually on hip and the other open palm inviting a conversation. Soft pale peach background with one flat cream circle.

characters.name: 픽
characters.direction: Skeptical curious personality. Mint green angular earcups, dark forest-green pullover hoodie without drawstrings. A single antenna bending slightly sideways with a mint cube tip. One eyebrow raised, small lopsided closed-mouth smile. One chunky robot hand touching chin, other arm folded. Pale sage background with one flat off-white rounded diamond.

characters.name: 모모
characters.direction: Inquisitive wide-eyed personality. Lavender oversized circular headphones, lilac sleeveless vest over cream long sleeves. Short antenna with a lavender oval tip. Head tilts 12 degrees, eyes very wide black dots and small open round mouth, one hand raised with index finger tentatively asking. Pale lavender background with a single flat ivory arch.

characters.name: 스파크
characters.direction: Bold spirited quick-rebuttal personality. Burnt-orange compact headphones with small bolt-shaped earpad accents, simple burnt-orange short-sleeved sports tee with cream side panels and no insignia. Small zigzag antenna and round tip. Determined playful eyebrows, confident grin. One fist planted into the opposite open palm at chest level, energetic but friendly. Pale apricot background with a single broad flat cream diagonal stripe.

characters.name: 누리
characters.direction: Patient calm listener. Powder blue soft rounded headphones, cream zip-up casual jacket with sky-blue sleeves. Thin upright antenna with blue round tip. Peaceful crescent eyes and small relaxed smile. Both hands held gently open, palms lowered in a calming gesture. Pale blue background with one flat off-white horizontal oval.

characters.name: 도도

Half-lidded black eyes, one slightly raised brow, knowing smirk. Arms loosely crossed, chin slightly tilted up. Pale mauve background with one cream flat rounded square.

characters.name: 토리

Short antenna with peach round tip. Happy closed crescent eyes and soft U smile, small blush. Friendly single hand wave, other hand near heart. Pale peach background with one ivory oval shape.

characters.name: 루프
characters.direction: Reflective deliberate thinker. Teal ring-shaped earcups, teal high-collar soft casual sweatshirt. A smooth curled antenna ending in a tiny round teal tip.
